Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1390
Claimant:
Bryan Malone
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
7-20-24
Claim received today for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured's vehicle was changing lanes. The claimant is
represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
8-11-24
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named driver with coverage in force at the time of
loss. No coverage issues identified at this stage.
9-1-24
Obtained the initial statement from the claimant, who describes the other vehicle drifting into the adjacent lane and
making contact along the driver's side. The account is consistent with the damage pattern noted at intake.
9-22-24
Witness statements and scene photographs were collected. Both witnesses and the other driver independently
describe the collision as the claimant described it.
10-3-24
Inspected the vehicle and documented the damage. Most of the damage lines up with the impact described, with the
principal deformation along the side panels and the mirror assembly. No prior damage to the vehicle is known from
our records or the owner's history.
10-23-24
The claimant reports a knee injury from the collision. The type of injury and the force involved in the crash appear to
match well. No prior injury to the same area is known from the medical history provided.
10-25-24
Received a supplemental statement from the claimant adding minor details about the moments before impact. These
additions are small, and the core account has remained unchanged across all statements.
12-5-24
Treatment records show a usual course of care for the knee, with symptoms easing steadily as the claimant
improved. Care has tapered off in line with recovery. It is not fully clear from the statement where the claimant was
seated in the vehicle at impact, and I have asked counsel to clarify.
1-6-25
A neighbor has told the field representative they believe the vehicle had already been damaged some weeks before
the stated date of loss. This is unverified and is being followed up, including a review of repair and photo history.
3-9-25
Reviewed the file with the neighbor's comment and the available records. The neighbor's recollection has not been
substantiated by any documents to date, and the claim remains open pending the seating position clarification and
the prior-damage check.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
